In one study, she and several coauthors partnered with a major U. S. dating platform to explore how updates to the app's algorithm could improve outcomes for romantic hopefuls looking to spark new connections.

Analyzing data from the app, Saban developed a model that not only prioritized potential matches based on a user’s preferences but also took into account the likelihood that the person on the other side of the potential match would be interested.
